details: Contributed to the re-orchestration of Amazon Translation Management Service, transitioning from a monolithic architecture to microservices
Integrated the system into a fully-native AWS environment by rewriting the pipelines
Led the integration of observability and monitoring mechanisms, including structured logging, metrics, and alarms, to proactively detect performance degradation and system anomalies
Participated in load testing and performance tuning efforts, analyzing bottlenecks in high-concurrency scenarios and improving system behavior under peak traffic conditions

Participated in complete software development lifecycle for six projects as a contractor and built high-performance device status products catering for over 3,000 developers, contributing to the system scalability and maintainability and successful delivery of key functionalities

Created essential features, modules, and auxiliary applications utilizing Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Oracle SQL, and Cassandra with effective containerization through Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD via GitLab pipelines
Maintained and optimized systems with tens of thousands of requests per minute, resolving more than 50 performance bottlenecks and enhancing system stability and performance by 35%
Collaborated with over 40 upstream and downstream stakeholders to achieve seamless integration, utilizing RESTful APIs, SOAP, Ldap search, resulting in a 25% reduction in integration issues
Facilitated over 100 code reviews and troubleshooting sessions within an Agile framework, elevating the technical proficiency of the entire team by 20%
Conducted regular technical knowledge transfer sessions and authored detailed technical documentation, ensuring projects’ maintainability and scalability

Participated in the complete SDLC of a microservice message-driven application with Angular TypeScript and Java Spring Boot framework, featuring facilitating user interaction, content sharing, and community building
Designed well-structured and highly interactive instructional content based on students’ learning characteristics, strengthening learners’ listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills
Collaborated closely with curriculum development teams to align teaching objectives with classroom needs, continuously refining instructional materials and delivery methods
Integrated videos, interactive exercises, and scenario-based learning activities to create an immersive learning environment and enhance student engagement and motivation
Conducted regular student feedback collection and learning outcome evaluations, iteratively improving teaching strategies and course design based on insights gathered
Achieved measurable teaching outcomes, including a 30% increase in classroom engagement and a 25% improvement in course completion rates
Supported over 3,000 students and 20+ teachers, contributing to improved learning effectiveness and the institution’s long-term educational goals
